### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Luteinizing Hormone (LH) is the hormone determinant for the development and maintenance of the corpus luteum during the first days following ovulation in an ovarian cycle without fertilization. LH stimulates the development and maintenance of the corpus luteum, supporting its function. Human Chorionic Gonadotropin (hCG) also plays a role in supporting the corpus luteum. Evidence paths confirm the relationship between LH and the structure of the corpus luteum, reinforcing LH's importance in this process.
